sentences.l2: 在大数据时代，我们的一举一动几乎都会被记录下来：购物偏好、出行轨迹、搜索记录，经过算法分析后，往往能勾勒出一个人的完整画像。
sentences.l1: In the big data era, almost our every move is recorded: shopping preferences, travel trajectories, search records, which after algorithmic analysis can often outline a complete portrait of a person.

sentences.l2: 企业借此提供精准服务，却也让隐私面临前所未有的风险。
sentences.l1: Companies use this to provide precise services, but it also exposes privacy to unprecedented risks.

sentences.l2: 许多用户在安装应用程序时，为了图方便，不加阅读便点击“同意”，无形中把大量信息交给了对方。
sentences.l1: Many users, when installing applications, for the sake of convenience click "agree" without reading, unwittingly handing over a large amount of information to the other party.

sentences.l2: 一旦发生数据泄露，不法分子便可能利用这些信息实施诈骗，给当事人造成难以挽回的损失。
sentences.l1: Once a data leak occurs, criminals may use this information to carry out fraud, causing the persons concerned irreparable losses.

sentences.l2: 为此，我国出台了《个人信息保护法》，明确规定处理个人信息必须取得本人授权，并遵循最小必要原则，不得过度收集。
sentences.l1: To this end, our country has issued the "Personal Information Protection Law", which clearly stipulates that processing personal information must obtain the individual's authorization and follow the principle of minimum necessity, and that excessive collection is not allowed.

sentences.l2: 同时，法律赋予个人查阅、更正乃至删除自己信息的权利。
sentences.l1: At the same time, the law grants individuals the right to access, correct and even delete their own information.

sentences.l2: 我们既要谨慎授权，定期清理不必要的权限，企业也应切实履行责任，才能守住隐私的底线。
sentences.l1: We must both grant authorization cautiously and regularly clear out unnecessary permissions, and companies should also earnestly fulfill their responsibilities, so that the bottom line of privacy can be held.
